checks.do: Whether the group's type matches the fields it sets, following the pairing rules.
Whether a rule still references the group before deleting it, since the delete helper sweeps firewall filtering rules only.
Whether the override flag is set deliberately on an update that edits addresses, since the default replaces the existing set.

type-values.statement: A destination group's type is one of DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN or DSTN_OTHER. The Python SDK rejects any other value for the list filter and the MCP tool enforces the same four values on input.

addresses-forms.statement: `addresses` may hold destination IP addresses, FQDNs or wildcard FQDNs.

quotes: Destination IP addresses, FQDNs, or wildcard FQDNs

field-pairing.statement: By the MCP field descriptions and the SDK examples, `addresses` is required for DSTN_IP and DSTN_FQDN, while `countries` and `ip_categories` are used with DSTN_OTHER.

quotes: IPs/FQDNs. Required for DSTN_IP or DSTN_FQDN.

pairing-not-enforced.statement: The MCP input model checks that `type` is one of the four values but does not cross-check it against `addresses`, `countries` or `ip_categories`, so a DSTN_IP group with no addresses is not rejected by that client-side model.
pairing-not-enforced.conditions: Rests on the absence of any cross-field validator in the input model, which was read in full. What ZIA does with such a request is unknown.

quotes: IPs/FQDNs. Required for DSTN_IP or DSTN_FQDN.

ip-categories-custom-only.statement: `ip_categories` on a destination group accepts only custom categories (the SDK example is CUSTOM_01).

non-editable-predefined.statement: `isNonEditable` is applicable only to predefined groups, which cannot be modified.

quotes: is applicable only to predefined IP address groups, which cannot be modified

exclude-type-excludes.statement: The SDK documents the list filter `excludeType` as excluding all groups that match the given type; the Python parameter name and the Go name carry the same query key.

quotes: Exclude all groups that match the specified IP destination group's type.

override-appends.statement: On update, the `override` query parameter controls how IPs are merged: false appends the supplied IPs to the existing set, otherwise the existing IPs are overridden, and the default is true. The Go client sends `override` only when its pointer is set.

expect.description: Indicates whether the IPs must be overridden. When set to false, the IPs are appended; else the existing IPs are overridden. The default value is true.

endpoint.statement: Destination groups are served at `/ipDestinationGroups` (list, create) and `/ipDestinationGroups/{id}` (get, update, delete) in the API capture and both SDKs.

expect.description:
Gets a list of all IP destination groups.

Note: This endpoint retrieves only IPv4 destination address groups. Organizations that have enabled IPv6 can use GET /ipSourceGroups/ipv6SourceGroups to retrieve IPv6 destination address groups.
expect.operationId: IP Destination Group Resource Get Destination IP Groups

fqdn-per-group-caps.statement: Destination groups hold up to 8,000 IP entries and FQDNs per group, but only 100 FQDNs per group by default (8,000 with Advanced Firewall).

quotes: | Destination Groups IP Address Entries and FQDNs per Group | 8,000 IP address entries |
| Destination Groups FQDNs per Group | 100 address entries8,000 address entries with Advanced Firewall |

exclude-type-wording.summary: The API capture and the SDKs describe the `excludeType` list filter differently.

expect.description: Filter based on the IP destination group's type.

positions.says: Filter based on the IP destination group's type.

quotes: Exclude all groups that match the specified IP destination group's type.

positions.says: Exclude all groups that match the specified type.

exclude-type-wording.impact: Read literally, the capture suggests an include filter; passing excludeType=DSTN_IP expecting only IP groups would return everything except them.

country-code-values.title: Valid country codes for a destination group
country-code-values.detail: MCP documents only the generic COUNTRY_XX form and SDK examples use COUNTRY_CA and COUNTRY_US. No mined file enumerates the full set.

custom-category-identifiers.title: Which custom category identifiers a destination group accepts
custom-category-identifiers.detail: `ip_categories` is documented as custom categories only with example CUSTOM_01. No source enumerates or validates the identifiers.

domain-type-fields.title: What a DSTN_DOMAIN group contains
domain-type-fields.detail: DSTN_DOMAIN appears only in the four-value enum lists. No example or per-type field rule exists for it, unlike DSTN_FQDN.

fqdn-cap-overflow.title: What happens when a destination group exceeds its FQDN cap
fqdn-cap-overflow.blocks: saying whether an over-cap write is rejected, truncated or accepted
fqdn-cap-overflow.detail: Unverified statement: What happens past the 100-FQDN default cap on a destination group (a tenant without Advanced Firewall) is not stated. The cap itself is in fqdn-per-group-caps; no source describes the API response or whether extra entries are dropped.
